note: O's subsystems as implemented on 2026-11-06, built from engine/o_engine, main/*.js, docs/plans/2026-11-04-o-ai.md and docs/research/2026-11-05-frontier-agents.md. Metrics are what the repo can measure; no benchmark number is claimed (docs/research/2026-11-05-frontier-agents.md section 3).

cu_grounding.description: Resolving a target (role/name text) to a screen element: accessibility tree first, cached locator second, vision grounder third.
cu_grounding.current: executor resolution order a11y -> LocatorCache (append-only, keyed by app+target+screen sha) -> Grounder (primary OpenAI-compatible VLM, Claude Code CLI fallback once). ZoomGrounder does two-step zoom-in with a zoom-consistency confidence; answers below cuGroundConfidence (default 0.3) are discarded and the fallback runs. MultiCropVote takes the mode of shifted crops.
metrics: offline grounding hit rate (engine/eval/osworld/offline.py, box contains recorded click)
vision fallback rate per run (resolved_by in run records)
ScreenSpot-Pro slice hit rate with/without zoom
limits: single generalist VLM slot (vllmVisionModel, empty by default -> Claude fallback)
no specialist/generalist routing cascade (GroundCascade-style)
zoom consistency is a weak confidence signal (AUC 0.60 per arXiv 2604.15376)
no candidate-box verifier (GUI-Actor style)

cu_planning.description: Turning a goal into OScript steps: milestone planning, per-observation next steps, best-of-N, heal/replan.
cu_planning.current: Planner.plan_milestones once per task then next_steps per observation (<= cuStepsPerTurn, default 5); replan_step heals one failed step (cuMaxHeals default 3); BestOfN ranks N candidate runs comparatively from behaviour narratives; FeasibilityGate runs read-only probes and one model question before planning. ModelClient: local vLLM first, `claude -p` fallback; JobMeter caps paid calls per job.
metrics: OSWorld task success (engine/eval/osworld/run_o.py + summarize.py; no number recorded yet)
paid model calls and cost_usd per job (cu/meter.py)
limits: fixed graph topology: context->plan->ground->execute->judge->store->report with heal as the only cycle
no context compaction beyond token-budgeted tree summaries
no search agent for unfamiliar workflows (VLAA-GUI)
no prompt-prefix cache measurement

cu_verification.description: Judging whether a step / goal succeeded.
cu_verification.current: a11y_assert on the tree (no model call) -> StateJudge for state_assert checks (file_exists/file_contains/file_sha_changed/tree/shell_true via the read-only probe allow-list) -> VLM/Claude screenshot judge only when the first two cannot decide. ScriptRunner loop breaker: >=3 identical (screen sha, step) pairs -> 'loop' heal reason.
limits: no trajectory-level judge (SeekJudge)
no generated app-specific state verifiers (OpenComputer)
probe allow-list is fixed and small (cu/probes.py)

cu_backends.description: Platform accessibility backends that expose the tree and act through accessibility APIs, never the host mouse.
cu_backends.current: AT-SPI2 (Linux, xdotool pixels only on the isolated display), AX via atomacos (macOS), UI Automation (Windows), FakeBackend for tests; allow_pixels only on isolated displays.
limits: macOS and Windows have no isolated display, so pixel fallback is off there
Electron/web apps often expose sparse trees

cu_memory.description: Task working memory, append-only procedures with replay, and per-app interfaces (notes + executable APIs).
cu_memory.current: WorkingMemory{facts,state,todos,risks} bounded, rendered after the static persona; ProcedureStore procedures/<app>/<key>/v<N>.json append-only with lineage, replay with zero model calls and HealLoop; InterfaceNotes markdown (400-line cap) and InterfaceStore/InterfaceBuilder versioned api.py with AST checks, fitness = replay pass rate.
limits: no cross-task semantic retrieval (embeddings) over procedures
interfaces built only from passing procedures, no exploration/practice (SkillWeaver)

learning.description: What O learns from the user and itself: preferences, schedules, per-app skill.
learning.current: observations.jsonl append-only record, profile.json derived cache with preference/schedule/app_skill items, scrub() strips secrets, LearnedNotes rendered into prompts.
limits: frequency/heuristic based, no learned ranking model
no evaluation of whether injected notes improve outcomes

parallel_tasks.description: Many tasks at once and role-partitioned planning.
parallel_tasks.current: main/tasks.js TaskManager: one Claude Code process + session per task, maxParallelTasks 1..8 (default 3), queue; swarm.py SimpleCrew (stdlib threads) or CrewAICrew over telemetry_auditor -> subprocess_compiler -> environment_inspector.
limits: no shared scratchpad or dependency graph between tasks
crew roles are fixed

goals.description: Long-term objectives O works on daily with journals, metrics and checkpoints.
goals.current: engine goals.py GoalStore journal.jsonl append-only (created/cycle records), next_cycle_prompt, targets_met/claims_success; main/goals.js schedules cycles via scheduler.js and gates checkpoint acts via main/tools/checkpoints.js.
limits: one cycle per cadence, no adaptive replanning between cycles
metrics are self-reported readings

ambient.description: Opt-in on-device presence sensing, milestones, wake brief, TTS, child-process supervision.
ambient.current: PresenceMachine over CSI/sonar/rPPG/face/OS idle; in-process bus (MQTT/Redis optional); MilestoneStore SQLite; Briefer (local-only model, 3 sentences, template fallback); PauseGate pauses low-priority jobs on return; Supervisor restarts vLLM/screenpipe with backoff.
limits: every sensor off by default and gated by an explicit consent sheet (protected)
presence thresholds are hand-set

genui.description: Declarative streaming GenUI frames rendered by the panel.
genui.current: A2UI-style Begin/Update/Data/End frames over a closed component set (Column, Row, Card, Text, Step, Tree, Progress, KeyValue, Button, Preview), parse_frame validation, Sandbox frames rendered in a sandboxed iframe; renderer/genui.js maps frames to DOM.
limits: closed component set; no A2UI spec version negotiation
no streaming partial-JSON repair

sandboxing.description: Disposable and isolated execution for high-risk and headless work.
sandboxing.current: containment.py select_sandbox: E2B cloud or one-shot Docker, /work only survivor; ambient/isolation.py select_isolated: microsandbox (libkrun) -> Firecracker (Linux+KVM, no network) -> Docker -> local path sandbox; runners.py NativeRunner / OpenInterpreterRunner.
limits: microsandbox pinned to SDK 0.7.13 API
no gVisor/WASM option

browser.description: Web automation in the user's browser and headless.
browser.current: main/agent.js drives Playwright MCP (@playwright/mcp) in the user's tabs through main/link.js (O Link extension CDP relay, payment sites refused); engine web.py BrowserUseRunner (browser_use.Agent on local vLLM, headless Chromium) and PlaywrightDomRunner for scripted DOM actions.
limits: browser-use pinned >=0.1.40 API
no WebArena/WebVoyager eval in repo

mcp.description: Calling the user's MCP servers and exposing O's own tools to Claude Code.
mcp.current: mcp_router.MCPRouter: stdio/SSE servers via the mcp SDK, tool listing with JSON schemas, args validated with jsonschema 2020-12 before sending; tools exposed as mcp__o__<name> (plan 'MCP tools exposed to Claude Code').
limits: no streamable-HTTP transport noted
no registry discovery of new servers

model_routing.description: Which model answers: local vLLM first, Claude Code CLI fallback; the OpenAI-compatible API proxy.
model_routing.current: cu/planner.py ModelClient (LocalModelClient then ClaudeCodeClient `claude -p --output-format json`, cost from total_cost_usd); parser.py; main/proxy.js turns OpenAI-style requests into `claude -p` runs with stream-json normalisation; tokenfilter keeps the first balanced JSON value.
metrics: paid calls and cost_usd per job
limits: default local model meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct (main/settings.js)
no structured-output / JSON-schema mode on the local endpoint

voice.current: ambient/tts.py and main/ambient.js: macOS say, Windows SAPI, Linux espeak-ng/spd-say; no speech input.
limits: no local STT
robotic OS voices
